parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:. The tag value cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The component name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

If you do not specify Name, the ImageComponentId return value is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
组件名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。

不设置`Name`时，默认使用`ImageComponentId`返回值
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The operating system supported by the component.

Valid values:
Linux
Windows

Default value: Linux
parameters.help_zh:
组件支持的操作系统。

取值范围：
Linux
Windows

默认值：Linux
parameters.name: system_type

parameters.help_en:
The component type. Image build components and test components are supported.

Valid values:
Build
Test

Default value: Build.
Build components can be used only in build templates, and test components can be used only in test templates
parameters.help_zh:
组件类型。支持镜像构建组件和测试组件。

取值范围：
Build
Test

默认值：Build。
构建组件只能在构建模板中使用，测试组件只能在测试模板中使用
parameters.name: component_type

parameters.example:
Tasks:
  - Name: HelloWorld
    Action: RunShellCommand
    Properties:
      commandContent: echo hello world
parameters.help_en: The component content, which consists of multiple commands. The content cannot exceed 16 KB. For more information about supported commands and command formats, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200206.html
parameters.help_zh: 组件内容。由多条命令组成，命令内容不能超过16KB。支持的命令和命令格式详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200206.html
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The component version number, which is used together with the component name. The format is major.minor.patch, and all values are non-negative integers.

Default value: (x+1).0.0, where x is the current maximum major version number of the component
parameters.help_zh:
组件版本号，与组件名称配合使用，格式为major.minor.patch，均为非负整数。

默认值：(x+1).0.0，x为当前组件最大的major版本号
parameters.name: component_version
